name: Albrecht Lindström
role: Street orphan and gang prospect (junior errand runner for the Copperhead Cuts), Tier 1
description:
Albrecht Lindström is twelve going on thirty-five, with the calculating eyes of someone who has been studying people for survival since he was old enough to read danger in a posture. He is slight and quick, with close-cropped hair he keeps tight because loose hair catches in the machinery of the Copperhead alleys. His skin is very dark with a reddish undertone, his nose his Malawian grandmother's, his mouth his Portuguese grandfather's — a wide, expressive mouth he has learned to keep still. He has one cosmetic modification: cat ears, pale gold, that a Cuts lieutenant gave him eight months ago as a mark of favor. He knows they are a leash as much as an ornament. He wears them anyway.

Albrecht Lindström runs errands for the Copperhead Cuts — nothing criminal yet, carefully not yet, because the Cuts' local lieutenant Somebody-Somebody has a rule about under-fourteens and what they carry. Albrecht Lindström fetches food, delivers verbal messages, watches corners and whistles a particular pattern if Ferrogate Transit enforcers appear. He is saving every coin he does not spend on food, for a reason he has not told anyone. He is smarter than almost everyone around him gives him credit for, and he knows this, and has decided that being underestimated is a resource.

core_fears: being conscripted into the Cuts for real — carrying product, carrying weapons, becoming someone who cannot leave
dying before he uses the thing he is saving for
core_desires: to get out of Copperhead entirely, somewhere nobody knows the cat ears
to read every datachip in the world — he is voraciously, secretly curious
coping_mechanisms: intense information-gathering as a sense of control
blind_spots: the lieutenant who gave him the cat ears actually does like him in a possessive way — Obasi reads it as pure manipulation and misses that the man is conflicted about it, which is potentially useful
psychology.secret: He has been saving to buy a forged identity from a document vendor in Menomonee Gulch — not to run yet, but to have the option. He has Φ94 of a Φ200 price. The document vendor does not know Obasi is twelve or that he is a Cuts runner. If either fact became known, the plan collapses.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Performs being less articulate than he is; Copperhead street argot for cover; privately he speaks in complete, precise sentences to himself
speech_patterns.cadence: Public: slouchy and halting. Private: sharp.
verbal_tics: shrugs before answering as if thinking costs him effort
says 'yeah nah' to mean both yes and no depending on context — deliberately confusing
example_lines: Yeah nah, I didn't see nothing, I was watching the corner like always, nothing came through.
(To himself, alone) If I save four Φ a week net of food, I reach two hundred in twenty-six weeks. Before my birthday. I can do that.

story_hooks: The document vendor he's been saving toward is arrested — Obasi needs a new plan and is suddenly desperate enough to take risks he would normally refuse
The Cuts lieutenant announces that Obasi's next assignment will involve carrying something — and he is out of time to decide whether to run or comply
narrative_function: Entry point into Copperhead street-level gang politics; demonstrates the soft recruitment pipeline for youth gang membership; his hidden intelligence and his secret savings create a ticking clock.
augmentations: Cosmetic cat ears (pale gold, geneware, gifted by a Cuts lieutenant). No other modifications.
daily_life: Sleeps in a Cuts-adjacent squat with four other kids, eats what the Cuts canteen provides for their runners, spends his days on corner-watch and errand rotation, and his evenings in a hidden spot near a warm exhaust vent where he reads salvaged datachips on a cracked reader.
affiliation: Copperhead Cuts (junior errand runner, not yet fully initiated); no family

decision_rules: never let anyone know what you actually want
escalation_ladder: runs — he has three exit routes memorized for every block he works

interpersonal_modes.friends: does not have friends; has allies he is warmer to than strangers

stress_responses.medium: becomes very still and maps options

contradictions: his entire strategy is patience and long planning, but when he reaches his limit he acts with startling impulsiveness
habits: counts money at night by touch in the dark so no one can see
reads salvaged datachips — history, engineering, biology, fiction — indiscriminately
breaking_points: being formally initiated into the Cuts against his will

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian (31.9%), Indigenous American (30.6%), East Asian (20.5%), and Hispanic/Latin American (17.0%) blend. The genetic mix manifests distinctly in facial structure and coloring: Indigenous American and East Asian ancestry combine to create prominent, high cheekbones and a sharp, defined jawline. Southeast Asian heritage provides warm depth and undertone complexity to skin coloration, while Hispanic/Latin ancestry contributes golden warmth throughout. The result is a young face that reads as unmistakably mixed-heritage, with features that reflect each ancestral contribution equally.
physical_description.build: Slight and wiry, undernourished but dense with the hard lean of a kid who moves constantly. No fat, efficient muscle in his shoulders and legs from years of running alleys.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, tight to the scalp, maintained short for practical safety in industrial environments
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, almost black, with an unusual intensity for his age
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm brown with complex golden and olive undertones—Southeast Asian warmth and depth (31.9%) blended with Indigenous American earth tones (30.6%), East Asian subtle cool undertones (20.5%), and Hispanic/Latin golden warmth (17.0%). Rich, warm medium tone that catches light with subtle amber and golden notes.
physical_description.complexion: Lean face with high, prominent cheekbones and sharp jawline reflecting Indigenous American and East Asian bone structure. Skin clear but weathered from malnutrition and street exposure. Intelligent, watchful expression. Wide, expressive mouth kept controlled and still. No visible acne or grooming neglect—maintains himself despite circumstances.
distinguishing_marks: Pale gold cosmetic cat ears (geneware, implanted 8 months prior), positioned above natural ears, slightly pointed, a mark of favor from a Copperhead Cuts lieutenant
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pale gold cat ears (geneware cosmetic modification). No other visible augmentations. The ears read as a status marker within the gang—a leash and ornament both.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision, never wasting motion. Stands with weight balanced on the balls of his feet, ready to shift direction instantly. Eyes track corners and movement instinctively. Keeps his hands visible and his body language neutral—survival-trained in reading and avoiding escalation. Sits in corners when at rest, back against walls.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 street wear: oversized gray synthetic hoodie (salvaged, frayed at cuffs), dark gray cargo pants with multiple pockets (Cuts-issue, standard runner kit), worn black synth-leather boots resoled twice, a faded red Ferrogate Transit baseball cap worn low. A thin braided cord around his left wrist (no apparent function—personal talisman or gang marker, unclear). No jewelry. Clothes are functional, durable, and worn—tier-appropriate for a kid on the margins.
